name: Allied Circuit Co., Ltd.
summary: Allied Circuit Co., Ltd., a Taiwanese company, specializes in the production and distribution of printed circuit boards (PCBs) for industrial and commercial sectors within Taiwan. The company's offerings include robust, high-reliability, and rigid multi-layer PCBs, alongside advanced High-Density Interconnect (HDI) technology. Established in 1995, Allied Circuit's operations are headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.
